This may lead to #> identifiability issues or unstable hazard estimates at the tail.

title: Consumer automobile loans dataset — aloans
text: dataset containing performance records 58,118 consumer automobile loans original terms 72 73 months. data obtained four publicly traded asset-backed securities (ABS) bonds. dataset subject left-truncation (loans must survive long enough included ABS trust) right-censoring (trust may unwound loans terminate), features competing risks default prepayment.

title: Consumer automobile loans dataset — aloans
code: aloans

title: Consumer automobile loans dataset — aloans
text: data frame 58,118 rows 13 columns: risk.cat Credit risk band based loan's Annual Percentage Rate (APR). Categories include "super_prime" (0-5%), "prime" (5-10%), "near_prime" (10-15%), "subprime" (15-20%), "deep_subprime" (20%+). Z Time--event, representing loan termination age months. Y Left-truncation time, representing loan age months ABS trust began making payments investors. C Right-censoring indicator (1 = right-censored, 0 = exact termination observed). D Default indicator competing risks (1 = default observed, 0 = prepayment observed right-censored). R Prepayment indicator competing risks (1 = prepayment observed, 0 = default observed right-censored). bond Categorical variable specifying source ABS bond: "carmax" (CarMax Auto Owner Trust 2017-2), "aart" (Ally Auto Receivables Trust 2017-3), "sdart" (Santander Drive Auto Receivables Trust 2017-2), "drive" (Drive Auto Receivables Trust 2017-1). orig.apr Obligor annual percentage rate orig.term Original loan term (months) orig.loan.amt Original loan amount abs0.age Loan age start asset-backed security abs0.balance Outstanding loan balance start asset-backed security calc.pmt Calculated monthly payment
